messages:
alex.k: Heads-up: release canary build blocked by supply-chain check. deploy-bot flagged missing 'source_url' for transitive dep 'libfastpatch' in the SBOM. change window in ~2h. @mira @jordan-sec can you triage?

mira: on it. can you paste the exact deploy-bot output?

deploy-bot: [automated] Release pipeline #canary failed supply-chain metadata check
```
check: sbom-metadata
component: libfastpatch
issue: missing source_url, missing checksum
severity: info (transitive)
build: artifact://release/canary/2026.3.20
```

alex.k: thx. lib is transitive via image-builder -> pinned at 0.7.2. unsure if upstream published source info.

sam: my 2c: missing checksum/source_url -> prefer pin by digest + release-note + legal signoff. avoid rollback unless vuln present.

jordan-sec: agree. i'll run a quick vuln scan and license check, ETA ~20m.

mira: also need provenance check: was the package fetched from a signed registry? infra, can you check artifact logs?

infra-bot: artifact-log: fetch from registry+mirror at 2026-03-20T08:15Z by build-9263. signature: none. registry checksum=abc123 (partial)

legal: pinged legal-review team for compliance. if license is unusual we may need to delay.

alex.k: decision proposal: hold canary, do not promote to prod. create release-note item documenting missing metadata and mitigation (pin-by-digest + follow-up). propose 90m triage within change window.

mira: timeline OK. i'll open PR to pin digest in image-builder and add release-notes bullet. assigning to sam for QA validation.

sam: will run regression tests on PR. if vuln scan is clean we resume; else rollback plan prepared.

jordan-sec: vuln-scan results: no CVEs in NVD or internal DB for 0.7.2. low risk. license shows MIT. recommend acceptance with documented tracking.

legal: reviewed license text, MIT okay. no export/compliance flags. approve conditional on release-note mention + tracking ticket.

alex.k: ok set: hold for 1.5h. if PR not merged by then we rollback the canary.

mira: creating ticket: RLS-5432 "transitive libfastpatch missing source in SBOM" assigned to eng/qa/legal. PR: https://github.com/redwood/image-builder/pull/831 :eyes: 

sam: PR merged -> will kick off QA runs; will call for resume when green.

ci-bot: [automated] canary rollout resumed by ci-bot. logs: rollout-step=canary, status=started

alex.k: thanks team :thumbsup:

mira: added release-notes bullet: "Addressed transient SBOM metadata omission for libfastpatch; pinned digest; tracked upstream fix RLS-5432."
